request.prompt: Create a polished HAVENLINE snowy settlement ARCHITECTURE STUDY using the supplied art as its family reference. This separate sheet covers protective buildings and safe access only: timber walls, a guardwalk, stairs, shelters and an empty observation platform. Do not depict weapons, ammunition, combat, targets or injuries. Render in chunky rounded stylized 3D mobile-game art with rich orange timber, blue panels/roofs, rounded gray stone and soft snow against a navy studio background. Show an impressive progression of usable architecture, not just recoloring. Six large panels in two rows of three. Top row GUARDWALK: one short solid timber palisade module on a stone foundation with a broad raised walkway on the camp side, a braced open observation platform, and one genuinely usable wide timber staircase from camp ground to an OPEN landing. Clear headroom and a gap in the landing railing at the stair top. Outside has strong supporting buttresses; inside has protected repair and pedestrian space. Bottom row FORTIFIED LOOKOUT: substantially larger masonry-and-blue observation tower with a roofed sheltered lookout deck, taller structural supports and a wider protected walkway; broad camp-side stairs remain open and connected. Add a separate covered supply alcove beneath the side of the platform, with ordinary closed tool crates and no equipment inside the empty top mounting area. It is a modest game module, not a giant castle. In each row column1 EXTERIOR shows the outside wall and tower front at three-quarter angle, column2 INTERIOR shows the true opposite camp side exposing the stairs and connected walkway, column3 ACCESS is a high three-quarter close view exposing the same continuous staircase→open landing→walkway→sheltered platform. These are three views of exactly the same physical structure in each row, not three variants. Keep stair side, number of platform levels, support placement, roof and wall endpoints consistent in every view. All structures fully in frame with margin. No gate in this module; no door punched into the solid wall, no additional entrance. Source images supply the existing rounded snow, timber and stone/blue style; these expanded tiers are new authored proposals. Header HAVENLINE / PROTECTIVE STRUCTURES. Footer ARCHITECTURE STUDY. Short labels only, no stats or numeric levels.
